{{small|(23 May 2026)}} | prevseason = [[2025 Veikkausliiga|2025]] | nextseason = [[2027 Veikkausliiga|2027]] | updated = 23 May 2026 }} The '''2026 [[Veikkausliiga]]''' is the 96th season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in [[Finland]], which takes place from April to November. [[Veikkaus]] is the league's main sponsor.{{#invoke:cite|web|title=2026 Veikkausliiga|url=https://www.soccerway.com/finland/veikkausliiga-2026/results/|publisher=Soccerway}} ==Teams== The league consists of twelve teams; ten teams remaining from the previous season, and two teams promoted from the [[Ykkösliiga]]. [[Kuopion Palloseura|KuPS]] entered the season as defending champions. ===Team changes=== {| class="wikitable" |- !Promoted from
[[2025 Ykkösliiga]] !Relegated to
[[2026 Ykkösliiga]] |- |align=center|[[FC Lahti]]
[[FC TPS|TPS]] |align=center|[[FC Haka]]
[[Kotkan Työväen Palloilijat|KTP]] |} The promoted teams are the [[2025 Ykkösliiga]] champions [[FC Lahti]] (returning to the top flight after a single-season absence), and [[2025 Veikkausliiga]] play-off winners [[FC TPS|TPS]] (returning to the top flight after a five-year absence). They replaced the 2025 Veikkausliiga bottom-placed team [[FC Haka]] (relegated after a six-year stint in the top flight), and Veikkausliiga play-off losers [[Kotkan Työväen Palloilijat|KTP]] (relegated after a single season). ===Stadiums and locations=== {{Location map+ |Finland |width=265 |caption=Location of teams in '''2026 Veikkausliiga''' |places= {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=65.01972|long=25.46583|label=[[AC Oulu|Oulu]]}} {{Location map~ |Finland |lat=63.673611 |long=22.695 |label=[[FF Jaro]] |position=right}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[FC Lahti|Lahti]] | position = top| lat = 60.98288 | long = 25.63446}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = '''Turku''' | mark = black pog.svg | position = top| lat = 60.442625 | long = 22.29192}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = '''Helsinki''' | mark = black pog.svg | position = right | lat = 60.187597 | long = 24.921643}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[IFK Mariehamn|IFK M]] | position = right | lat = 60.102222 | long = 19.935278}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[Ilves (football)|Ilves]] | position = top | lat = 61.492766 | long = 23.764132}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[Kuopion Palloseura|KuPS]] | position = bottom | lat = 62.884594 | long = 27.671908}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[Seinäjoen Jalkapallokerho|SJK]] | position = bottom | lat = 62.778793 | long = 22.814775}} {{location map~ | Finland | label = [[Vaasan Palloseura|VPS]] | position = top | lat = 63.085228 | long = 21.627995}} {{Location map~ |Finland |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |marksize=1 |lat=68.5 |long=34.5 |label_size=80 |label= {{nowrap|'''Helsinki teams'''
